segments.en:
Enemy forces are standing by in the areas
marked on the map.

Repel the enemy forces and
liberate those areas.
The enemies guarding those strongholds are overwhelmingly strong.
First, you'd do better to fight the enemy units you run into in normal airspace and gain some experience.
